bouquets.name: Valentine's Classic
bouquets.question: flowers for valentines day
bouquets.reason: Red roses are the traditional symbol of romance, and red tulips echo their colour while adding a softer, more open shape to the bunch.

bouquets.name: Birthday Sunshine
bouquets.question: something cheerful for a birthday
bouquets.reason: Three yellows with different shapes: the tulips are neat and rounded, the black-eyed Susans bring a dark centre for contrast, and the dahlia adds one large showy bloom.

bouquets.name: Spring Garden Party
bouquets.question: purple flowers for a garden party
bouquets.reason: The allium globes give height and structure, jacaranda softens the arrangement with trailing blossom, and larkspur fills the gaps with deeper violet.

bouquets.name: Quiet Condolences
bouquets.question: flowers for a funeral
bouquets.reason: Soft purples read as respectful and restrained, which suits a sympathy arrangement better than anything bright.
bouquets.note: This gallery has no white flowers, which are the usual choice for sympathy — these purples are the closest fit available.
